{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMakeLists.txt, depends/Makefile, and CI configuration to bump the language standard to C++23 and raise minimum compiler requirements to GCC 13 and Clang 19.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "unblocks #34979",
      "rationale": "Raising the minimum language standard to C++23 represents a major toolchain transition across the build system. It unblocks modernization work and downstream dependencies such as issue #34979 and libmultiprocess C++23 adoption."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/release-notes-36033.md solely as a release note accompanying the build and utility changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates that merely follow from code changes do not make a PR a member of the docs category."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/txospenderindex.cpp only for mechanical C++23 modernization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical updates following standard library changes do not constitute index changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp only for mechanical replacement of util::Expected with std::expected.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental call-site adjustments in kernel files do not affect kernel boundaries, APIs, or isolation."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/i2p.cpp only for mechanical C++23 standard library migration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Pass-through modernization of string functions does not affect P2P protocol, transport, or peer handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches several RPC files (such as src/rpc/util.cpp, src/rpc/server.cpp, src/bitcoin-cli.cpp) to adapt to std::expected and std::string::contains.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical syntactic modernizations do not alter RPC behavior, interfaces, or output format."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removes obsolete polyfill test src/test/util_expected_tests.cpp and updates various test call sites mechanically.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updating test call sites and deleting tests for dropped utility polyfills merely follows the main build and utility changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin-tx.cpp and contrib/devtools/bitcoin-tidy/CMakeLists.txt for standard updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical call-site changes in tools do not alter tool functionality or interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies core utility headers including src/util/expected.h, src/compat/byteswap.h, and src/util/types.h to retire internal polyfills in favor of std::expected and std::byteswap.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Retiring internal polyfills like util::Expected and ALWAYS_FALSE in favor of standard library implementations reduces custom utility maintenance across the codebase. While worthwhile, these internal modernizations are deferrable cleanups."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/blockstorage.cpp only for mechanical C++23 standard updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical edits across validation files without changes to validation rules or state management do not make a PR validation."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches wallet source and test files purely for mechanical migration to C++23 idioms.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Downstream call-site migrations do not alter wallet logic, storage, or APIs."
    }
  ],

    "security_stability": 0,

  }
}
